summary: Phase 5b — In-app Notification Bell — full backend + frontend regression. Built new pytest suite (18/18 PASS after 1 xdist race-timing fix) covering: auth 401 across all three /notifications endpoints, list response shape (id/kind/title/body/link/entity_kind/entity_id/actor_label/is_read/created_at), ?unread=1 filter + unread_count math, dispatch on PO submit → supplier queue (title 'New PO <code>', entity_kind=purchase_order, link=/martbaked/sellers/portal/orders), PO acknowledge → partner queue, PO ship → partner queue, auto-draft invoice on PO receive → supplier queue (title 'Draft invoice <SINV-code> ready', link=/martbaked/sellers/portal/invoices), invoice submit → partner (body contains match_status token), invoice approve → supplier, invoice dispute → supplier (body contains reason), single-read POST /{scope}/notifications/{id}/read persists is_read=true + read_at, read-all POST clears unread_count to 0 for all rows, cross-tenant isolation (Alpha partner PO codes never leak to Beta partner queue), atomic dispatch on 409 double-submit (no phantom notification row created). Frontend verified in all three portals: partner top-nav bell shows badge=10 (from prior seed runs), dropdown opens with 10 rows, row-click → POST /read + navigation to /partner-portal/invoices, Mark all read clears badge to hidden + 'You're all caught up' state. Supplier bell in sidebar header — badge=1, dropdown opens with 11 rows, row-click navigates to /martbaked/sellers/portal/orders, Mark all read clears badge. Admin bell in sidebar footer — dropdown opens with 0 rows + notification-empty state (expected: no dispatch site targets recipient_kind='admin' in Phase 5b).

issues: The NotificationBell dropdown uses absolute right-0 positioning, so when the bell sits inside the collapsible left sidebar header the 384px-wide dropdown extends OFF-SCREEN to the left (partially clipped). Consider left-aligning the dropdown (left-0) or docking it relative to the viewport when the bell is in a left column. Non-blocking — dropdown still opens and rows are clickable.

action_items: (Optional) Left-align NotificationBell dropdown when mounted inside a left sidebar (supplier portal) so the 384px panel doesn't clip off the left viewport edge.
(Optional) Consider dispatching admin-tier notifications (e.g. supplier onboarding submissions, PO overdue, invoice disputed >48h) — admin bell currently shows only the empty state.

(Optional) NotificationBell.jsx line 15 shadows the built-in browser `fetch` with a local `const fetch = useCallback(...)`. Purely stylistic — no bug — but could rename to `refresh` to avoid the shadow.
critical_code_review_comments: shared/notifications/routes.py::notify — the try/except swallows ALL insert failures silently (only logs). Given the docstring promises atomic-with-parent-txn semantics, that's actually intentional (never fail the parent transition on a notification write). Good.

shared/notifications/routes.py::_admin_dep — deferred import of get_current_admin avoids a circular import, but returning the dep from a function factory (Depends(_admin_dep())) works only because get_current_admin itself is a callable — subtle. A single top-level import guarded by TYPE_CHECKING would be cleaner.
shared/notifications/routes.py — no DELETE endpoint or archive/soft-delete. Long-lived accounts will accumulate rows forever. Consider a background TTL sweep or a max-age filter in _list().
shared/notifications/routes.py — `limit=Query(40, le=100)` is fine; there's no offset/cursor for pagination. Fine for a bell UI showing latest 40, but note if a future 'View all' page is added.
NotificationBell.jsx — the local `fetch` name shadows global fetch (see action_items).
NotificationBell.jsx — `KIND_COLORS` is missing entries for 'po_received' which is imported but never dispatched from server side (harmless dead entry) — the color palette is fine.

PO submit hook (purchase_orders/routes.py line 638) — `await _po_line_count(...)` is called on every notify and returns a full list of PK ids just to len() it — could reuse the count already computed in the transition (`lines` variable) instead.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (bell + dropdown + row-click + mark-all-read verified in all 3 portals)

All notifications for these cycles are marked read at end of run (mark-all-read tests) so the badge state is empty by test end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 5b regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_notifications_phase5b.py — pytest xdist-safe (mark-all-read baseline is measured relatively, not absolutely, to tolerate concurrent worker dispatches). It creates NEW POs each run and mark-alls-read at teardown, so it's rerun-friendly. Frontend testids used: [data-testid=notification-bell-btn], [data-testid=notification-badge], [data-testid=notification-dropdown], [data-testid=notification-mark-all-read], [data-testid=notification-row-<notif_id>], [data-testid=notification-empty]. Admin queue is currently empty by design (no server-side dispatch targets recipient_kind='admin' yet).
